name: Divadelní under Národní, out of the south mouth by the National Theatre
why: the street's last 18 m before the underpass, between the stairs down from Národní beside the theatre and the wall of náměstí Václava Havla: the build took them for the inside of the tunnel and gave the middle of the carriageway the height of Národní, 4 m up, a paved bank across the mouth that people walked down from Národní. The LiDAR has the street level at 188.0–188.3 m right up to the mouth. The outline is the carriageway alone: the stairs' ground beside it stays the slope it is
